signal: Sonatype released its 2026 State of the Software Supply Chain report in January, reporting open source downloads up 67 percent and a 75 percent rise in malicious packages.

email.body1:
Adam, saw Sonatype just dropped the 2026 State of the Software Supply Chain report, open source downloads up 67 percent and malware up 75 percent.

Demand spikes like that put more in-market accounts in play than a region can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sonatype off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Adam, quick follow-up for Sonatype.

When the market wakes up to supply-chain risk, the target on a region usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Adam, last bit of proof for Sonatype.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatype reply rate likely compares to other security platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Adam, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know running a region is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I will tailor it to Sonatype either way.
